releases.summary: Extends local terminal teams to more CLI agents and improves attach and view recovery.

changes.text: Added a CLI assistant provider registry so Codex, Claude, and experimental local Antigravity CLI members share Team lifecycle while keeping provider-specific launch, activity, and delivery behavior.
Separated terminal layout selection from Team member identity and kept launcher-specific placement behind layout strategies.
Kept attach watchdog cancellation active through a running-session read and made stopped-session detection deterministic.
Replaced Windows Terminal panels whose attach ended after a session stop while preserving healthy panels and preventing duplicate windows when a stale panel cannot close.
Started managed Claude sessions with classic terminal rendering to preserve scroll and text selection in Windows attach views.
Started managed Codex create and resume sessions with scrollback-friendly terminal rendering.
Forwarded function-key input through the terminal attach command.
Improved mobile and Server Web terminal attachment, including reconnect and retained terminal display behavior.
Reconciled already closed Windows Terminal views without failing Team hide or closing unrelated terminal windows.
Recognized Codex hook review as a pending user interaction and prevented active startup placeholders from satisfying provider readiness.

Antigravity CLI integration remains experimental and local. Native provider setup and hook or tool approvals remain user-owned; the isolated Codex hook-trust configuration write failure is not automatically repaired by this release.

Current physical fresh-start, first-hook, desktop, mobile and Server Web acceptance and two-server A10-A12 verification remain incomplete; source tests and package verification do not replace these live checks.

releases.summary: Adds an experimental local Antigravity CLI projection and updates provider hook compatibility for Termbrio 0.5.10.

changes.text: Added a reproducible local Antigravity CLI plugin projection from the shared skills, HTTP MCP endpoint and bounded activity hooks. This is experimental local support, not an Antigravity marketplace publication.
Registered and validated Claude StopFailure and PermissionDenied hook events.
Requires Termbrio 0.5.10 or newer. Native setup, plugin hook trust and tool permissions remain explicit user decisions; experimental AGY live acceptance remains incomplete.

releases.summary: Unifies Team authoring, lifecycle, linked collaboration, and named terminal views.

changes.text: Added one canonical schema-6 Team definition for workspaces, local and remotely placed owned members, persistent linked agents, and named views.
Added columns-3, main-right-stack, and left-stack-main semantic layouts with stable pattern and slot identities.
Added Server Web authoring for schema-6 workspaces, owned members, linked agents, named views, layout groups, and panels.
Separated owned-member lifecycle from named-view placement so unavailable members no longer block healthy members and valid panels.
Made repeated start reuse existing views, hide preserve sessions, and stop close Team-owned views while recording remote failures per member.
Connected owner-controlled remote SessionHosts directly to their Owner Server for durable commands, TeamRelay MCP, attach, reconnect, and stop.
Resolved linked-member views and reconnects through exact owner-authorized session evidence without guessing by display name or local session.
Stopped attach panes from claiming an exited session was still running or retrying forever after the remote runtime became unavailable.
Made create-once create until a real provider conversation identity exists, recover an explicitly stopped incomplete create attempt, and resume that exact conversation on later starts.
Kept rejected portable session drafts editable while preserving fixed session ID and reference bindings.
Added one-hop team_info visibility for authorized linked-into teams without recursive federation expansion.
Let phone and tablet Team surfaces attach an exact owned member without starting the whole Team and project linked members without duplicating Team cards.
Adopted termbrio.db as the canonical Server database without migrating pre-release Team storage.

releases.summary: Teaches agents the canonical schema-6 Team, named-view, and linked-member contracts.

changes.text: Author only schema-6 Team files with workspaces, owned agents, persistent linked agents, and named presentation views.
Keep owned-member lifecycle independent from view placement, isolate unavailable remote members per member, and recover explicitly stopped incomplete create-once attempts without database resets.
Use paired workspace and runtime aliases in portable files while retaining stable ownership and authority inside Termbrio Server.
Discover authorized linked-into teams through one-hop team_info without recursively expanding federation.

releases.summary: Adds owner-controlled remote teams and capability-aware TeamRelay delivery.

changes.text: Added owner-controlled remote SessionHost execution through paired Server brokers.
Added semantic safe, active-turn, queue, and authorized interrupt delivery policies with per-recipient audit outcomes.
Show placed team members with their Runtime Server while preserving one owner-controlled team definition.
Preserved canonical remote sender addresses and route replies back to the originating Server.
Hardened remote SessionHost handoff, claim expiry, stop ordering, attach routing, and pre-hook Codex readiness detection.
Added structured product changelog and catalog projection contracts for unattended release delivery.

releases.summary: Teaches terminal agents the 0.5.8 remote-team and TeamRelay contracts.

changes.text: Document canonical federated sender addresses, source-Server replies, and exact wildcard recipient scope.
Document Owner Server authority separately from a paired Runtime Server that hosts a placed terminal.
Clarify semantic delivery policy outcomes and safe-boundary handling when no working provider turn is observed.
